name: Comb Pick (padlock bypass)
description: A comb pick is designed specifically for spring-loaded padlocks. Its toothed profile simultaneously depresses all spring-loaded pins in the lock, allowing the shackle to release. It is a direct mechanical bypass rather than a picking technique and works without any skill or feedback. Most cheap padlocks used on storage cages, utility rooms, and equipment cabinets are vulnerable to this approach.

blue.det: Padlock opens without key; comb pick tool visible; camera footage.
blue.cm: Replace spring-loaded padlocks with pin tumbler or disc detainer padlocks; use closed-shackle or shrouded designs; electronic access for high-security applications.
